purpose: Observations, not naturalness or successful recovery verdicts. R0 rejected: healthy also fails, and unsupported down still receives artificial lift.
rawLocation: Raw snapshots retained outside repository in /workspace/halfsword-hybrid-evidence. See hashes below.

protocol.injury: hurt changes only legF=.45; wound applies cut severity.8/60J with actual bleeding; disabled changes both legs=.2. Synthetic injuries, not clinical calibration.
protocol.input: player move0, autoGuard true, enemy parked; harness G.step intact
protocol.forceMeaning: contactImpulse sum / DT is raw API interpretation; historical 6/7 is unvalidated here, retained separately
protocol.pointMeaning: actual solver world contact point; velocityAtPoint minus fixed floor velocity; not COM speed. Contact existence alone is not load-bearing.
protocol.jointMeaning: rest-relative rotation vector in joint frame; x/y magnitude is off-local-z bending, not clinical knee valgus
protocol.outcomeMeaning: observed means tool completed, not human-like recovery success
